newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down 12 cents to 15.03 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down 12 cents to 15.03 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell 12 cents to 15.03 ringgit ($6.01) a kg as players continued the week's spate of selling, prompted by an overnight fall on the London Metal Exchange.
"The market has been generally oversold this week and there were more offerings today because of the LME's fall," said a dealer. The LME closed $35 lower on Wednesday.

Turnover fell to 100 tonnes from 120 tonnes on Wednesday. Bids totalled 85 tonnes against offers of 135. Dealers said there was a discount of $15 a tonne to LME, unchanged from Wednesday.--Barani Krishnaan (603-230-7509) ($1=2.5000 ringgit)
